types.name: swap.v1.CancelSwapRequest
types.doc: CancelSwapRequest cancels one of the caller's Swaps.

fields.name: swap_id
fields.doc: Swap ID.

types.name: swap.v1.CancelSwapResponse
types.doc: CancelSwapResponse is the Swap as the cancel left it.

fields.name: swap
fields.doc:
The Swap: CANCELING until what was already placed finishes, or
 RECONCILING while an order's outcome is being confirmed; already
 terminal; or, after the Swap's deadline, unchanged (EXECUTING or
 RECONCILING, without cancel_requested_at).

types.name: swap.v1.CreateSwapRequest
types.doc: CreateSwapRequest creates and executes a Swap.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc:
Client-chosen key, unique per caller, that makes creation idempotent: the
 same key and request return the same Swap; another request with the same
 key is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Keys starting "aw:" are reserved for
 auto-withdraw's conversions and refused (INVALID_ARGUMENT).

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Terms to execute.

fields.name: min_amount_out_e18
fields.doc:
Positive minimum destination amount after fees for the whole amount, in
 18-decimal units, usually the quote's min_amount_out_e18. An order that
 matches within its window never nets a lower rate: its price limit allows
 for the taker fee in force then. What cannot be traded at that rate stays
 on the account. An order the exchange first accepts after its window
 (only under severe delay) may pay a later scheduled fee; if that takes a
 fill below the minimum rate, the Swap fails closed with MINIMUM_NOT_MET.

fields.name: quote_expires_at
fields.doc:
The accepted quote's expires_at. The Swap is refused with QUOTE_EXPIRED
 once it has passed.

types.name: swap.v1.CreateSwapResponse
types.doc: CreateSwapResponse is the created (or existing) Swap.

fields.name: swap
fields.doc: The Swap.

types.name: swap.v1.ErrorCode
types.doc: ErrorCode identifies a Swap API error.

values.name: ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED
values.doc:
No spot market trades the source asset against the destination asset,
 directly or through USDT or USDC.

values.name: AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE
values.doc:
The amount is outside the market's current limits. The error carries the
 limits (min_amount_e18, max_amount_e18) when known.

values.name: QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: No price is currently available for the route; retry later.

values.name: PROTECTION_UNACHIEVABLE
values.doc:
Current order-book depth cannot deliver min_amount_out_e18 (or the
 requested slippage): request a new quote.

values.name: QUOTE_EXPIRED
values.doc: quote_expires_at has passed: request a new quote.

values.name: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
values.doc:
The idempotency key was already used with a different request. The error
 carries the original swap_id.

values.name: SWAP_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: No Swap of the caller matches the selector.

values.name: INVALID_SUBACCOUNT_ID
values.doc: subaccount_id is not a valid sub-account ID.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: The sub-account does not exist.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_INACTIVE
values.doc: The sub-account is not active.

values.name: SWAP_NOT_PERMITTED
values.doc:
The caller may not Swap on the account: the role, the API key's policy or
 the sub-account's policy does not grant SWAP, or a root-scoped API key
 selected a sub-account.

values.name: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: A required service is temporarily unavailable; retry the same request.

values.name: DIRECTION_UNSUPPORTED
values.doc:
A market of the route trades its two assets but cannot execute a Swap in
 this direction: a buy there would pay its fee in the asset it spends.

values.name: SWAP_ALREADY_FINAL
values.doc:
The Swap ended before it was canceled; the error carries its swap_id.
 Read it with GetSwap.

values.name: SWAP_NOT_CANCELABLE
values.doc:
The Swap converts an auto-withdraw payout and ends only with its
 auto-withdraw run.

types.name: swap.v1.ErrorDetail
types.doc:
ErrorDetail is attached to Swap errors as an error detail of type
 swap.v1.ErrorDetail.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable error code.

fields.name: swap_id
fields.doc:
IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT and SWAP_ALREADY_FINAL only: the Swap bound to the
 idempotency key, or the Swap that ended.

fields.name: min_amount_e18
fields.doc:
AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE only: the smallest amount that currently quotes, in
 18-decimal units of the source asset. Guidance, not a guarantee.

fields.name: max_amount_e18
fields.doc:
AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE only: the largest amount current depth absorbs in one
 order within the market's maximum order quantity, in 18-decimal units of
 the source asset. A buy above it would buy more than the maximum order
 quantity, so it is refused rather than partly executed.

types.name: swap.v1.Execution
types.doc: Execution selects how a Swap is traded.

fields.name: market
fields.doc: Execute immediately.

fields.name: twap
fields.doc: Execute in equal time slices.

types.name: swap.v1.GetSwapRequest
types.doc: GetSwapRequest selects one Swap of the caller.

fields.name: swap_id
fields.doc: Swap ID.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc: Idempotency key the Swap was created with.

types.name: swap.v1.GetSwapResponse
types.doc: GetSwapResponse is the selected Swap.

fields.name: swap
fields.doc: The Swap.

types.name: swap.v1.ListSwapsRequest
types.doc:
ListSwapsRequest lists the caller's Swaps funded by one account, newest
 first.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional sub-account public ID whose Swaps to list. When omitted, the
 Swaps funded by the caller's root account are listed, or those of the
 sub-account an API key is bound to.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: open_only
fields.doc: When true, only Swaps that have not ended (is_terminal false) are listed.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum number of Swaps to return: 0 means 20, at most 50.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque, exclusive, keyset-backed cursor from a previous response's
 next_page_token. It is bound to the caller, subaccount_id and open_only,
 and to the newest-first creation order with a stable tie-breaker for
 Swaps created at the same instant; reuse it only with the same values.
 Empty for the first page.

types.name: swap.v1.ListSwapsResponse
types.doc: ListSwapsResponse returns one page of Swaps, newest first.

fields.name: swaps
fields.doc:
Swaps ordered by creation time, newest first, each as GetSwap returns
 it.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: swap.v1.MarketExecution
types.doc: MarketExecution executes the Swap at once, in immediate orders.

types.name: swap.v1.QuoteSwapRequest
types.doc: QuoteSwapRequest asks for a quote of terms.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Terms to quote.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
fields.doc:
Accepted shortfall from the expected output, in basis points (1 bp =
 0.01%), from 1 to 1000; sets the quote's min_amount_out.

types.name: swap.v1.QuoteSwapResponse
types.doc: QuoteSwapResponse is the quote.

fields.name: quote
fields.doc: The quote.

types.name: swap.v1.Side
types.doc: Side is a spot order side.

values.name: BUY
values.doc: Buy the market's base asset with its quote asset.

values.name: SELL
values.doc: Sell the market's base asset for its quote asset.

types.name: swap.v1.Swap
types.doc:
Swap is one signed-in Swap and its outcome. Amounts count settled fills
 only.

fields.name: swap_id
fields.doc: Swap ID.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc: Idempotency key the Swap was created with.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Sub-account public ID funding the Swap; 0 for the root account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: source_asset_id
fields.doc: Asset spent.

fields.name: destination_asset_id
fields.doc: Asset received.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc: Source amount requested, in 18-decimal units.

fields.name: min_amount_out_e18
fields.doc:
Minimum destination amount after fees for the whole amount, in 18-decimal
 units. Each traded part nets at least this rate.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current status.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc:
Why the Swap did not trade its whole amount; set with
 PARTIALLY_COMPLETED, FAILED and CANCELED.

fields.name: is_terminal
fields.doc:
True once the status is final: COMPLETED, PARTIALLY_COMPLETED, FAILED or
 CANCELED.

fields.name: executed_amount_e18
fields.doc: Source amount spent in settled fills, in 18-decimal units.

fields.name: unspent_amount_e18
fields.doc:
Source amount not spent, in 18-decimal units; it never left the
 account. Final once is_terminal is true.

fields.name: received_amount_e18
fields.doc: Destination amount received after fees, in 18-decimal units.

fields.name: orders
fields.doc: The Swap's spot orders, in placement order.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the Swap was created.

fields.name: execution
fields.doc: How the Swap executes.

fields.name: intermediate_asset_id
fields.doc:
Unified asset ID of a two-leg route's intermediate asset; zero for a
 direct route.

fields.name: intermediate_remainder_e18
fields.doc:
On a two-leg route, intermediate asset received and not converted, in
 18-decimal units; it is on the account. Final once is_terminal is true.
 Zero for a direct route.

fields.name: legs
fields.doc: The route's markets in order, with each leg's settled totals and fee.

fields.name: progress
fields.doc: Execution schedule and slices; unset before execution is planned.

fields.name: cancel_requested_at
fields.doc:
When the Swap's owner first canceled it (CancelSwap); unset when it was
 never canceled. Set once and never changed. A cancel that came when
 nothing was left to stop leaves the Swap's outcome as it would have been
 (for example COMPLETED), with this set.

types.name: swap.v1.SwapLeg
types.doc: SwapLeg is one market of a Swap's route and its settled totals.

fields.name: leg
fields.doc: Zero-based position of the market in the route.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Stable numeric pair ID from GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: Side of the leg's orders.

fields.name: spent_e18
fields.doc:
Amount the leg spent in settled fills, fees in the spent asset included,
 in 18-decimal units of the asset it spends.

fields.name: received_e18
fields.doc:
Amount the leg received in settled fills after fees, in 18-decimal units
 of the asset it receives.

fields.name: fee_e18
fields.doc:
Fee charged on the leg's settled fills, in 18-decimal units of
 fee_asset_id.

fields.name: fee_asset_id
fields.doc: Asset the leg's fee is charged in: the asset it receives.

types.name: swap.v1.SwapOrder
types.doc:
SwapOrder is one spot order of a Swap: an immediate-or-cancel limit order
 at the Swap's protection price, on one leg of one slice.

fields.name: order_id
fields.doc: Spot order ID, once the market accepted the order; 0 before.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Stable numeric pair ID from GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: Side of the order.

fields.name: leg
fields.doc: Zero-based position of the order's market in the Swap's route.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: State of the order.

fields.name: limit_price_ticks
fields.doc:
Limit price in quote-asset price ticks (1e-9 quote units per base unit):
 the worst price at which the order nets the Swap's minimum rate after fees.

fields.name: spent_e18
fields.doc:
Amount the order spent in settled fills, fees in the spent asset included,
 in 18-decimal units.

fields.name: received_e18
fields.doc:
Amount the order received in settled fills after fees, in 18-decimal
 units.

fields.name: fee_e18
fields.doc:
Fee charged on settled fills, in 18-decimal units of the asset the order
 receives.

fields.name: slice
fields.doc:
Zero-based slice of the Swap's schedule the order belongs to; 0 at
 market.

types.name: swap.v1.SwapOrderStatus
types.doc: SwapOrderStatus is the state of a Swap's spot order.

values.name: PLACING
values.doc: The order is being placed.

values.name: PLACED
values.doc: The order was accepted by the market.

values.name: REFUSED
values.doc: The order was refused before it reached the market.

values.name: NOT_PLACED
values.doc: The order was not placed before the execution window ended.

values.name: UNCONFIRMED
values.doc: The order's outcome is being established.

types.name: swap.v1.SwapProgress
types.doc: SwapProgress is a Swap's execution schedule and slices.

fields.name: completed_slices
fields.doc: Slices that traded source amount and are over.

fields.name: total_slices
fields.doc:
Slices of the schedule: 1 at market, duration_ms over slice_interval_ms
 rounded up for a TWAP; zero until execution is planned.

fields.name: started_at
fields.doc:
When a TWAP's schedule started, its first slot; unset at market and
 until the TWAP is planned.

fields.name: deadline
fields.doc:
The last moment an order of the Swap may be sent: the TWAP's start plus
 its duration, or the end of the market execution window. Unset until
 execution is planned. An order sent before it may settle, and an order's
 outcome be confirmed (RECONCILING), after it; the Swap is terminal only
 then.

fields.name: slices
fields.doc:
A TWAP's slices in index order, at most 50, including future slices.
 Empty at market.

fields.name: slices_truncated
fields.doc:
True when the TWAP has more than 50 slices; only the first 50 are
 listed, and completed_slices still counts them all.

types.name: swap.v1.SwapQuote
types.doc:
SwapQuote is an estimate from current order-book depth. Nothing is
 reserved: the prices are indicative, and only min_amount_out binds once the
 Swap is created.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: The quoted terms.

fields.name: legs
fields.doc:
Markets the Swap would trade on, in order: the direct market between the
 two assets when one exists, otherwise two markets through
 intermediate_asset_id (USDT or USDC), the route with the largest
 expected output.

fields.name: expected_amount_out_e18
fields.doc:
Estimated destination amount after fees, in 18-decimal units, at current
 order-book depth. A buy spends the whole source amount at the prices
 available up to its price limit; what the book cannot fill within the
 limit stays in the account.

fields.name: min_amount_out_e18
fields.doc:
Minimum destination amount after fees at the requested slippage, in
 18-decimal units. Create the Swap with this value (or another accepted
 minimum) as min_amount_out_e18: whatever is executed then nets at least the
 same rate, and what cannot be stays on the account.

fields.name: quoted_at
fields.doc: When the quote was priced.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc:
Last moment the quote may be accepted, 30 seconds after quoted_at. Pass it
 as quote_expires_at when creating the Swap.

fields.name: intermediate_asset_id
fields.doc:
Unified asset ID of a two-leg route's intermediate asset (for example
 USDT for BTC to SOL); zero for a direct route.

fields.name: price_impact_bps
fields.doc:
Distance of the whole amount's average execution from the best prices
 of the books, across every leg, in basis points, rounded up:
 1 - (1 - impact of leg 1) x (1 - impact of leg 2).

fields.name: total_slices
fields.doc:
Slices the Swap executes in: 1 at market; for a TWAP, duration_ms over
 slice_interval_ms, rounded up. A TWAP is quoted as the whole amount at
 current depth, an estimate of every slice.

types.name: swap.v1.SwapQuoteLeg
types.doc:
SwapQuoteLeg is one spot market a quote trades on. The first leg of a
 two-leg route receives the intermediate asset and the second spends it.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Stable numeric pair ID from GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: Side of the order on the market.

fields.name: average_price
fields.doc:
Estimated average fill price, quote asset per base asset, as a decimal
 string; for display.

fields.name: price_impact_bps
fields.doc:
Distance of average_price from the best price of the book, in basis points,
 rounded up: the cost of the order's size against current depth.

fields.name: taker_fee_rate_percent
fields.doc:
The account's spot taker fee rate on the market, in percent (for example
 "0.1" for 0.1%), as a decimal string.

fields.name: fee_e18
fields.doc:
Estimated fee, in 18-decimal units of the asset the leg receives
 (fee_asset_id): the leg's received amount times its taker fee rate. A
 second leg is priced on what the first leg receives after its fee.

fields.name: fee_asset_id
fields.doc: Asset the fee is charged in: the asset the leg receives.

types.name: swap.v1.SwapReason
types.doc: SwapReason says why a Swap did not trade its whole amount.

values.name: INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE
values.doc: The Trading balance did not cover the amount when the order was placed.

values.name: PRICE_PROTECTION
values.doc:
The order books could not fill the rest at a price that meets
 min_amount_out.

values.name: MARKET_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: The market was closed, halted, restricted or without liquidity.

values.name: ORDER_SIZE_OUT_OF_RANGE
values.doc: The order was outside the market's size limits.

values.name: RATE_LIMITED
values.doc: The account's order rate limit was reached.

values.name: ORDER_REJECTED
values.doc: The order was refused, for example by the sub-account's trading policy.

values.name: EXPIRED
values.doc:
The execution window ended before the order could be placed, or a
 TWAP's deadline ended it with slots left untraded.

values.name: MINIMUM_NOT_MET
values.doc:
A fill netted less than the accepted minimum rate. The Swap failed closed:
 the amounts show exactly what was traded and received.

values.name: MAX_ORDER_QUANTITY
INTERMEDIATE_BELOW_MINIMUM
values.doc:
On a two-leg route, intermediate asset below the second market's minimum
 order, with later slices' intermediate added where a TWAP had slices
 left, stays on the account, unconverted (intermediate_remainder_e18).

values.name: USER_CANCELED
values.doc:
The Swap's owner canceled it (CancelSwap) before its whole amount
 traded.

types.name: swap.v1.SwapSlice
types.doc:
SwapSlice is one slot of a TWAP Swap's schedule, including a slot that
 traded nothing. Its index and planned_at never change.

fields.name: index
fields.doc: Zero-based position in the Swap's frozen schedule.

fields.name: planned_at
fields.doc: Frozen scheduled start of the slot.

fields.name: executed_at
fields.doc: When its first order was sent; unset for an unsent slice.

fields.name: finished_at
fields.doc: When its outcome became final; unset while planned or executing.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Current slice state.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Why a final slice did not trade in full; unspecified after full trading.

fields.name: completed
fields.doc: Whether the slice traded source amount and is over.

fields.name: input_traded_e18
fields.doc:
Source amount the slice's first leg spent in settled fills, in
 18-decimal units.

fields.name: output_received_e18
fields.doc:
Destination amount received in the slice after fees, in 18-decimal
 units. On a two-leg route this is its second leg's output, which can
 include intermediate carried from earlier slices.

fields.name: second_leg_input_e18
fields.doc:
On a two-leg route, intermediate amount the slice's second leg spent, in
 18-decimal units; zero on a direct route.

fields.name: intermediate_carried_e18
fields.doc:
On a two-leg route, intermediate acquired through this slice, from it and
 earlier slices, that no second leg had converted by its end, in
 18-decimal units: added to a later slice's second leg when none could be
 ordered (carry_reason), otherwise left on the account. Zero on a direct
 route.

fields.name: carry_reason
fields.doc:
Why intermediate asset could not be converted in this slice;
 unspecified when no conversion was refused.

types.name: swap.v1.SwapStatus
types.doc: SwapStatus is the state of a Swap.

values.name: EXECUTING
values.doc: The Swap is accepted and its orders are being placed, filled or settled.

values.name: COMPLETED
values.doc:
The whole amount was traded and settled (a remainder smaller than one
 order step stays on the account, unspent).

values.name: PARTIALLY_COMPLETED
values.doc:
Part of the amount was traded and settled; the rest stays on the account,
 unspent. reason says why.

values.name: FAILED
RECONCILING
values.doc:
An order's outcome is being established. Balances already reflect any
 settled fill; the Swap stays here until the outcome is confirmed. A
 canceled Swap shows RECONCILING too while it waits for such an outcome
 (see CancelSwap).

values.name: CANCELING
values.doc:
The Swap's owner canceled it (CancelSwap) and the cancel is taking
 effect: no new slice or first-leg order is sent. An order already sent
 finishes, and a slice whose first leg traded still sends its second
 leg. The Swap then becomes terminal: CANCELED, or the outcome it would
 have had when the cancel came too late to stop anything. This usually
 takes seconds. While an order's outcome is being confirmed the Swap is
 RECONCILING instead, and CANCELING again once it is, until it ends.

values.name: CANCELED
values.doc:
The Swap's owner canceled it (CancelSwap) before its whole amount
 traded. The amounts show exactly what traded and settled; the unspent
 amount and any intermediate_remainder_e18 stay on the account. reason is
 USER_CANCELED.

types.name: swap.v1.SwapTerms
types.doc:
SwapTerms are the economic terms of one Swap: spend amount_e18 of the
 source asset from the account's Trading balance and receive the destination
 asset there, at market or over time. The same terms are quoted and created.
 A Swap executes as spot orders at the account's own spot taker fee on each
 market it trades; no other fee is charged.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional sub-account public ID whose Trading balance funds the Swap. When
 omitted, the caller's root account funds it, or the sub-account an API key
 is bound to.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: source_asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset spent: a unified asset ID, as used for balances and internal
 transfers.

fields.name: destination_asset_id
fields.doc: Asset received: a unified asset ID.

fields.name: amount_e18
execution
fields.doc: How the Swap executes; unset executes at market.

types.name: swap.v1.TwapExecution
types.doc:
TwapExecution spreads the Swap evenly over a duration, one slice per slot.
 Slot k starts k slice intervals after execution starts. Each slice trades
 what is left of the amount over the slots left, and each slice nets at
 least the Swap's minimum rate (min_amount_out_e18 over amount_e18) on what
 it converts, judged slice by slice; slices whose intermediate one later
 second leg converts together (below) are judged together. Each order's
 price limit allows for the taker fee in force when the order can match
 within its window, the highest rate scheduled from when the order is
 prepared until it can last be accepted, some minutes after its sending
 window since a delayed order can still be accepted then. An order the
 exchange first accepts after that window (only under severe delay) may pay
 a later scheduled fee, and a slice it takes below the minimum fails the
 Swap closed (MINIMUM_NOT_MET). A slice's first order is sent only within
 its slot: a slot missed is skipped, never sent late. On a two-leg route, a
 slice's second leg is sent once its first leg has settled, at any time
 before the deadline, even after the slice's slot, and the next slice
 starts only once it is over. When no second-leg order can meet the
 protection or the second market's order limits, the slice's intermediate
 asset is added to the next slice's second leg. What a second-leg order
 leaves unfilled, and what is still unconverted when execution ends, stays
 on the account (intermediate_remainder_e18), and the Swap then ends
 PARTIALLY_COMPLETED; a rest smaller than one order step of the second
 market is ordinary residue and the Swap can still end COMPLETED. A TWAP
 needs a larger amount than a market execution, since every slice must be a
 valid order.

fields.name: duration_ms
fields.doc:
Total execution duration in milliseconds, from 60000 (1 minute) to
 86400000 (24 hours). The duration starts when execution starts, not when
 the Swap is created.

fields.name: slice_interval_ms
fields.doc:
Interval between slices in milliseconds, from 10000 (10 seconds) up to
 duration_ms. The slice count is duration_ms / slice_interval_ms, rounded
 up.
